contributions.name: Yolk Change Intelligence
contributions.description: Inspect semantic impact before edits and compare behavior after code changes
contributions.instructions: Yolk indexes named functions and methods and their static call graph. It does not observe Solid/React tracking, store reads inside callees, effects, or runtime dependency leaks, so it cannot diagnose UI reopen loops or similar reactive bugs. Use inspect_change for shared named-function impact; if the exact symbol is unknown, pass a source path and retry once with an exact returned symbol. Automatic post-edit notes are optional caller-review guidance, not a diagnosis or a required checkpoint. Unknown or partial confidence is not extra evidence. Prefer exact fail-before/pass-after regressions, direct code tracing, and focused review. Never create probe files or restart TurenOS to refresh the index.
